name: Yogurt
description: Records and transcribes meetings locally without a bot, writes summaries with an on-device model, and lets AI assistants read notes via a local MCP server.

skills.name: Live Transcription
skills.description: Transcribes microphone and call audio on your computer as you talk, in English or 99 languages in multi-language mode.

skills.name: Meeting Summaries
skills.description: Writes a summary of each meeting and your own notes with a local open-weight model, so nothing leaves the machine.

skills.name: Ask Across Meetings
skills.description: Answers questions across all your recorded meetings and links each answer back to the transcript it came from.

skills.name: Read Notes over MCP
skills.description: Serves meetings, notes and transcripts read-only to an assistant app through a local MCP server you switch on.
